page.overview:
Who is Ao Shun?

Ao Shun belongs to Journey to the West. The is the Dragon King of the North Sea.

Ao Run and the other Dragon Kings were summoned by Ao Guang when Sun Wukong demanded to be given a new set of clothes. Ao Run was quick to agree with his demands, giving Sun Wukong his Cloud Walking Boots.

In Journey to the West, Ao Shun sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
